methods.when: A public directory or source must be discovered.
methods.do: Inspect authorized complete directories, source indexes and actual links before guessing paths; reuse intact saved material.
methods.avoid: Repeated speculative requests without new persisted evidence.
methods.limitations: Generalized historical method; access permission, freshness and the current Brief still govern. No historical success rate is promised.

methods.when: A tool reports success or an extraction returns zero.
methods.do: Read saved bytes and hashes; distinguish real source text, challenge pages, placeholders and missing values before deciding what was found.
methods.avoid: Treating a status flag, search snippet or empty parser result as verified business evidence.
methods.limitations: Intact bytes prove integrity only. Semantic meaning, source authority and business criteria still need assessment.

methods.when: Collected candidates are saved or delivered.
methods.do: Reconcile unique input objects with stored, held and rejected objects; reopen the actual export and its source references.
methods.avoid: Counting repeated rows as independent organizations or reporting file creation as delivered research.
methods.limitations: A complete export can contain unresolved candidates; report business completeness separately.

methods.when: A venue, organization, person or contact route is classified.
methods.do: Bind each relationship to source text and the current Brief. One organization may operate several venues; customers and equipment suppliers differ.
methods.avoid: Inferring a role from an address or applying a historic named-person requirement to every task.
methods.limitations: The current task defines target roles and whether a named person is required. This method cannot change those rules.

methods.when: A method stops yielding evidence or a later observation contradicts prior advice.
methods.do: Append the correction and counterexample. Use the authorized finite budget and measured yield to stop or change the method.
methods.avoid: Rewriting historical evidence, treating UNKNOWN as zero, or expanding spend because a method failed.
methods.limitations: No fixed historical ROI threshold is adopted. Stop conditions come from current authorization and task criteria.

methods.when: Search discovery is useful for the current task.
methods.do: Use bounded localized queries, retain discovery provenance, then acquire the actual source before asserting facts.
methods.avoid: Treating search snippets as source-page evidence or repeating equivalent searches.
methods.limitations: Account availability and costs are checked at runtime. Search success does not establish entity or contact quality.

methods.when: A supported search engine or structured search mode fits discovery.
methods.do: Use the admitted engine schema and required parameters; persist returned source candidates before selecting pages to acquire.
methods.avoid: Guessing engine-specific parameters or assuming a successful search validates source claims.
methods.limitations: Available engines and account entitlements must be observed; this advice grants no extra calls.

methods.when: An authorized public page needs source acquisition.
methods.do: Check browser and restricted egress readiness, capture real source content, and persist its hash before extracting facts.
methods.avoid: Interpreting challenge or access-denied pages as empty business results.
methods.limitations: A failed site remains blocked; use another authorized source or HOLD, without bypassing access controls.

methods.when: A reviewed TinyFish capability fits a public research step.
methods.do: Use the embedded admitted MCP connection and the exact supported capability; retain source and operation references.
methods.avoid: Silently switching a bounded fetch to a paid browser-agent task.
methods.limitations: Provider-derived text remains candidate evidence. Runtime schema, credentials, budget and permission remain authoritative.

methods.when: A supported structured judgment can help interpret already saved evidence.
methods.do: Bind input to saved material and constrain the choice to the current task's criteria; persist the result as a candidate judgment.
methods.avoid: Treating model judgment as a new source or final business approval.
methods.limitations: Semantic validation is still required; a judgment cannot supply missing source facts, permission or budget.
